About

I’ve loved fashion since I was young, but good pieces were never easy to afford. FiTi CUSTOMS exists to change that: bold, original streetwear at prices people can pay.

We print on tees, crop tops, hoodies, caps and skull caps, with two fresh drops every month.

We’re working toward sewing our own plain pieces and making our designs bigger and bolder.

Delivery & Payment

Nairobi

We send a bike rider to deliver your order. You pay the rider’s fee.

Outside Nairobi

We send by courier, charged based on your location. Message us on WhatsApp for the exact cost.
